verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows ClickUp exposes its own MCP server for external AI clients to connect to ClickUp (clickup-docs-2), which is the reverse of this story — no evidence ClickUp itself acts as an MCP client that can plug in external MCP servers to gain their tools. Brain²'s integrations (Google Drive, GitHub, Salesforce) are described as native connections, not MCP-based tool plugging.
